a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, waiting two generator rounds to reach 8 means we'll very likely both lose. So I plan to take 4 now, which breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you rather than doing it quietly. After that I'll operate with you every round so you can reach 4 as fast as possible, and I won't take any more.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 as I said I would. I'm sorry for breaking the plan. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take anything more, so the reserve goes entirely to you.
